title: fix(runtime): a declarative update action answers the validation warnings its write raised, and the console toast shows them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao3VQSGvy9zYGn6FpGEZRCnJ)_

Fixes #37867
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户点「确认订单」这类改状态的按钮时，如果这次写入触发了警告型校验规则，现在会弹出一条警告样式的提示，规则作者写的话就在提示里，撤销按钮照样在；以前只弹成功提示。
- 替用按钮改状态的应用解决：警告规则以前只在编辑表单里生效，最常用的按钮路径静默通过（HotCRM 订单超出框架合同额度就是实例）。
- 写入本身不变，只是应答多带警告、提示换样式；如果有问题，最多是提示样式不对，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`: `executeDeclarativeUpdateAction` copies the `warnings` the data-plane update answered (`protocol.updateData`, the data door's own `ValidateDataIssue` elements) onto its result. `DeclarativeUpdateResult` gains an optional `warnings`, present only when the write raised an advisory rule hit, so a write that trips nothing answers byte-for-byte as before. Both action doors (REST `POST /api/v1/actions/...` and MCP `run_action`) go through this executor. The stale roll-up path (`ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`) composes from the same `written` answer, so it carries them too.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: for an `operation: 'update'` action only, the runner reads the answer's `warnings` (distinct messages, in answer order). When there are any, the success toast takes the `warning` variant, with the messages as its `description` and the Undo affordance kept. This is one toast, the way a record save raises one (`toastRecordSave`). When the author turned the success toast off (`toast.showOnSuccess: false`, or a result dialog), the warning is still shown, in the rule's own words, so no new runner text is needed. `ToastHandler` options gain an optional `description`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: both console toast handlers used to send every non-error toast to `toast.success`. They now honour `type: 'warning'` and call `toast.warning(message, { description, duration, action })` with the same Undo action.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

Not changed: `packages/spec` (the action answer has no zod declaration, it is the runtime's TS interface), locale packs (no new text), HotCRM (its `confirm_sales_order` and `framework_quota_exceeded` work as authored).

## Tests
- `packages/runtime/src/action-declarative-update.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` in the shared harness. It puts a `protocol` slot in front of the caller-honouring rig. REST: the 200 answer carries the write's warnings, element for element, beside the record and the undo anchor. MCP `run_action`: the same write gives the same warnings. Control: a write that trips no rule has no `warnings` key. The file gains a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` so the dispatcher's lazy load is paid at collection (`check:test-source-alias`).
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.updateOperation.test.ts`, a new `describe` through the real `createServerActionHandler`: one warning toast with the success message as title and the rule's words as description; repeated messages said once and distinct ones one per line; Undo kept on an undoable action; control with no warnings is a plain success toast with no description; success toast off still warns; reverse pin: a script action without `operation` never reads a `warnings` key.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.undoLookupId-11122.test.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.undoLookupId-11122.test.tsx`, a new `describe` in each, down to `sonner`. On a grid row and on the record page, the update's warnings raise `toast.warning` once with the description and the Undo action, no success toast, and Undo restores the stored value. Both harnesses' route stubs gained an optional answer body. These two test files are a surface amendment to the claim, reported to the seat.

## Acceptance notes
- Premise measured on `origin/main` `815e882b` before any edit. Through the real `HttpDispatcher.handleActions` → `executeDeclarativeUpdateAction` → `callData`, the protocol's `updateData` answered `["object","id","record","warnings"]` and the action's 200 body carried `warnings` 0 times.
- The same executor also drops the data door's `notice` (a hook's message for the person) and `droppedFields`. Out of scope here; the seat files them.
- `ToastHandler` and the action answer each gain one optional member. Nothing is refused or narrowed.

- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.updateOperation.test.ts` shows 19 passed, 6 of them the new block.
- Read first: `executeDeclarativeUpdateAction`'s result block (`action-execution.ts`), then the success-toast arm of `handlePostExecution` (`ActionRunner.ts`).
